ADHD doctor on the Gold Coast: how to get assessed now.

The honest starting point: nobody in the ADHDme network has rooms on the Gold Coast today. What you can reach from the Gold Coast, right now, is a GP assessment by phone and a group of psychologists and an occupational therapist in Brisbane, all of whom also work by telehealth.

Find your clinician →How booking works

Who a Gold Coast patient can see today

The GP is Sydney-based and takes phone consultations. The psychologists and the occupational therapist have rooms in Brisbane and see people by telehealth as well.

What the Gold Coast has, and what it does not

ADHDme lists clinicians who have declared how they work, where they practise and what they charge. As of today that includes Brisbane, Sydney, Perth and the Snowy Mountains. The Gold Coast is on the list of places the network is growing into, and when a Gold Coast clinician joins they will appear on The Network page and here.

That leaves two real routes from the Gold Coast now. One is a GP assessment by phone. The other is a psychologist in Brisbane, in the room or on a screen.

A GP assessment by phone

Dr Anubhav Saxena is a GP in Sydney who declares phone consultations alongside practice appointments. Booking is on his practice’s own Healthengine page, in a new tab, with no referral and no account. Whether the whole assessment can be done by phone, and what has to happen in person, is the practice’s call, so ask when you book.

A GP assessment through the network is $299 for the first consultation and $199 for the follow-up, $498 in total. The two together are the assessment and the diagnosis. There is no Medicare rebate on either. The practice sets and charges the fee, and ADHDme receives no part of it.

One thing to know about medication. Queensland changed its rules on 1 December 2025. A specialist GP, meaning one with FRACGP or FACRRM fellowship, can now diagnose ADHD in an adult and start, adjust and continue stimulant medication without a psychiatrist signing off first. Queensland GPs have been able to prescribe for children since 2017. A GP who practises in another state works under that state’s rules, so ask the practice what applies to you.

Psychologists an hour up the M1

GOALS Psychology is in Fortitude Valley, with level access from the car park and an hour of free client parking, and Neutral Minds Psychology is in Ashgrove. Both are about an hour’s drive from the Gold Coast, and every psychologist at both sees people by telehealth. Two of them, Lachlan Avent and Meera Lakhani, do ADHD and autism assessment; the others work on what comes after a diagnosis.

Each psychologist sets their own fee, and it is on their profile. With a Mental Health Treatment Plan from a GP, Medicare pays part of up to 10 sessions a year: $101.55 a session for a registered psychologist and $149.05 for a clinical psychologist, at the current rates.

A psychologist can assess ADHD and treat it with therapy, but cannot prescribe. If medication is part of what you want, the GP route above is the one that leads there.

After the diagnosis

Diagnosis is the start, not the end. The treatment after diagnosis page walks through what usually follows: medication and its reviews, therapy, occupational therapy for daily life, coaching, and the parts you can do yourself.

Questions people ask

Is there an ADHD doctor on the Gold Coast in the ADHDme network?

Not yet. The Gold Coast is on the network’s planned list. Today the nearest rooms are in Brisbane, and a GP assessment is available by phone.

Can a GP diagnose ADHD in Queensland?

Yes. Since 1 December 2025 a specialist GP in Queensland can diagnose ADHD in an adult and prescribe stimulant medication. GPs have been able to prescribe for children in Queensland since 2017.

Do I need a referral?

No. Every clinician on ADHDme is booked or enquired with directly, on the practice’s own page. A GP will write a Mental Health Treatment Plan if you want Medicare to pay part of psychology sessions later.

Is there a Medicare rebate on the GP assessment?

No. The GP assessment is $498 in total across two consultations, with nothing to claim back. Psychology sessions under a Mental Health Treatment Plan do attract a rebate.

How will I know when a Gold Coast clinician joins?

They will appear on The Network page. ADHDme Weekly, the newsletter in the footer, is the other place it will be announced.

Read the clinicians, then book or enquire on the practice’s own page.
